# `candid onboard`

Ingest resume/LinkedIn into your profile.

## Usage

```
usage: python -m candid onboard [-h] [--resume RESUME] [--linkedin LINKEDIN] [--out OUT]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--resume` `RESUME` | Resume file (.pdf/.md/.txt) |
| `--linkedin` `LINKEDIN` | LinkedIn export file (.txt/.md) |
| `--out` `OUT` | Where to write profile.json (default: candid_data/) |
